verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a community post quoting Morph's privacy policy. Per that quote, free-tier code may be used for training, while the Enterprise tier restricts use to processing the immediate request. So users can avoid training only by being on Enterprise, and it is unclear whether paid non-enterprise users are covered. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of the data-use policy, a self-serve training opt-out for non-enterprise users, clarity on paid-tier retention and training, and independent corroboration.
